title: Nemed colonizes Ireland
summary: Nemed leads the second colonization of Ireland in the Irish annals.
description: Nemed leads the second colonization of Ireland in the Irish annals. Recorded from a CFAH OSF preprint anchor point (not yet published in ARJ). Added by the CFAH pass.
